title: Add ray query instance mask and self-shadow hit overlay for debugging
purpose: Disambiguate which TLAS is contributing to hits and visualize self-shadow queries in the mesh pass.

steps.detail: Assign unique instance masks: external TLAS = 0x01, shell TLAS instances = 0x02. In ray queries, set cullMask accordingly to isolate tests (e.g., self-shadow queries use 0x02).
In particle_mesh.frag, add debug mode 'rtSelfShadowOverlay' that colors fragments by hit distance bucket (e.g., green close, yellow mid, red far, purple no-hit).
Expose runtime toggles: rtSelfShadowOverlay, rtCullMaskSelfOnly, rtCullMaskExternalOnly. Log state changes.
Disable overlay in release; ensure one ray query per fragment with early alpha discard path.

acceptance: Overlay displays hit/no-hit patterns when enabled
Self-only mask isolates shells; external-only mask isolates occluders
No frame-time spikes >10% when overlay disabled
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('Ray query cullMask and SBT record mask semantics')
notes: Ensure TLAS instance masks are set during TLAS build for shells. Bind-time cannot change instance masks; rebuild if needed.
